title: Pure Chronomaly
summary: Pure Chronomaly Xyz strategy fielding ancient Machines and Rocks with signature Number monsters, bolstered by the modern support wave. Led by Chronomaly Magella Globe, Nebra Disk, and Temple - Trilithon, the deck rapidly manipulates Levels to summon Rank 4 and 5 Number bosses like Chronomaly Vimana and Number 36: Chronomaly Chateau Huyuk.

summary.title: Starters
points: Chronomaly Nebra Disk on Normal Summon searches any Chronomaly card from your Deck, and revives itself from the GY while you control only Chronomaly monsters.
Chronomaly Magella Globe tributes itself to Special Summon any Chronomaly monster directly from your Deck, and banishes an Xyz Material to return from GY to hand.
Chronomaly Tuspa Rocket on Normal or Special Summon sends a Chronomaly monster from Deck or Extra Deck to the GY to reduce a monster's ATK, and enables a Number Xyz to attack twice.
Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon grants an additional Normal Summon of a Chronomaly monster each turn and can be sent to the GY to substitute for an Xyz detachment.

summary.title: Opening: Chronomaly Nebra Disk + Chronomaly Moai
steps: Normal Summon Chronomaly Nebra Disk, activating its effect to add Chronomaly Tuspa Rocket (or Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon) to your hand.
Special Summon Chronomaly Moai from your hand since you control a Chronomaly monster.
Use Chronomaly Temple - Trilithon to Normal Summon Chronomaly Tuspa Rocket, sending Chronomaly Acambaro Figures from your Deck to the GY.
Activate Acambaro Figures in the GY, paying 1000 LP to Special Summon itself as a Level 5 monster.
Overlay two Level 5 Chronomaly monsters to Xyz Summon Chronomaly Vimana.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Chronomaly Vimana is a Rank 5 boss that attaches a monster from either GY to itself as material, gains ATK, and detaches two materials as a Quick Effect to negate an activated monster effect.

Number 36: Chronomaly Chateau Huyuk detaches a material as a Quick Effect to drop any opponent face-up monster's ATK to 0, and tributes a Chronomaly monster to destroy an opponent's monster whose ATK is different from its original ATK.

Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech targets a monster whose ATK differs from its original ATK, inflicting burn damage equal to that difference and gaining ATK equal to the damage dealt, creating sudden OTK opportunities with Chateau Huyuk.
Number C6: Chronomaly Chaos Atlandis equips an opponent's monster to gain 1000 ATK, and detaches 3 materials to reduce the opponent's LP directly to 100.
Chronomaly Crystal Chrononaut protects itself from battle destruction by detaching a material, serving as an early defensive wall or glyph target.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Chronomaly Esperanza Glyph targets a Chronomaly Xyz Monster, Special Summons two Chronomaly monsters from your hand or GY that are 1 Level higher than its Rank, and immediately Xyz Summons a Chronomaly Xyz Monster using them as material.
Chronomaly Technology banishes a Chronomaly monster from your GY to excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck and add 1 to your hand.
Chronomaly Acambaro Figures can discard itself from the hand to prevent a Chronomaly monster from being destroyed by battle or card effect.
